# Ignite UI for React v19.11 — Full API Reference

> Complete API reference for the Ignite UI for React package (19.11). This file lists all public classes, interfaces, enumerations, type aliases, functions, and variables with their signatures, parameters, and descriptions.

Platform: React
Package: igniteui-react
Version: 19.11

## Classes

### [IgrAccordion](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrAccordion)
The Accordion is a container-based component that can house multiple expansion panels
and offers keyboard navigation.

- **singleExpand**: `boolean` — Whether only one panel can be expanded at a time. When the user expands a
panel, the other panels collapse.
- **panels**: `any` — The direct expansion panel children of the accordion.
- **hideAll**(): Promise<void> — Hides all of the child expansion panels' contents.
- **showAll**(): Promise<void> — Shows all of the child expansion panels' contents.

### [IgrAvatar](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrAvatar)
Shows the identity of a user, for example in a user profile.

- **alt**: `string | undefined` — Alternative text for the image.
- **initials**: `string | undefined` — Initials to use as a fallback when no image is available.
- **shape**: `AvatarShape` — The shape of the avatar.
- **src**: `string | undefined` — The image source to use.

### [IgrBadge](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrBadge)
Shows a status on a related item, or marks an area that needs attention.

- **dot**: `boolean` — Whether the badge renders as a small dot without content.
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the badge has an outline.
- **shape**: `BadgeShape` — The shape of the badge.
- **variant**: `StyleVariant` — The type (style variant) of the badge.

### [IgrBanner](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrBanner)
A non-modal notification banner that displays important, concise messages
requiring user acknowledgement.

The banner slides into view with an animated grow transition and renders
inline, pushing the surrounding page content rather than overlaying it.

The component supports the
[Invoker Commands API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API).
A button with command="--show", "--hide" or "--toggle" and a
commandfor that points to this element calls the matching method.

- **open**: `boolean` — Whether the banner is open.

Setting it skips the animation and the close events. Use the show(),
hide() and toggle() methods for an animated transition.
- **hide**(): Promise<boolean> — Closes the banner with an animated grow-out transition.

Returns true when the banner was successfully closed, or false if it
was already closed or closing, the transition was superseded by a newer
one, or open was set to false and then to true during it.
- **show**(): Promise<boolean> — Opens the banner with an animated grow-in transition.

Returns true when the banner was successfully opened, or false if it
was already open or opening, the transition was superseded by a newer one,
or open was set to false during it.
- **toggle**(): Promise<boolean> — Toggles the banner open or closed depending on its current state.

Equivalent to calling show() when closed and hide() when open.
Returns true when the transition completed successfully, with the same
false cases as these methods.

### [IgrBreadcrumb](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrBreadcrumb)
A single item within a breadcrumb navigation trail.

- **current**: `boolean` — Whether the breadcrumb represents the current page.
Sets aria-current="page" on the element when true.
- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether the breadcrumb is disabled.
Sets aria-disabled="true" on the element and removes the slotted
content from the tab sequence while true.

### [IgrBreadcrumbs](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrBreadcrumbs)
A breadcrumb navigation component that renders an ordered list of breadcrumb items.

- **separator**: `string` — The icon name used as the default separator between breadcrumb items.
Can be overridden per-item using the separator slot on an individual breadcrumb item.

### [IgrButton](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrButton)
Represents a clickable button, used to submit forms or anywhere in a
document for accessible, standard button functionality.

The button has several visual variants. It renders as an anchor (<a>)
element when the href attribute is set. It is form-associated and can
act as a native submit or reset control.

- **command**: `string | undefined` — The command to invoke on the target element specified by commandfor.
Part of the [Invoker Commands](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API) API.
Custom commands must start with two dashes (e.g. '--my-command').
- **commandfor**: `string | null` — The ID of the target element for the invoker command.
Part of the [Invoker Commands API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API).
- **commandForElement**: `Element | null` — The target element for the invoker command. Resolved from the `commandfor` ID.
- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether the button is disabled. A disabled button ignores user interaction.
- **download**: `string | undefined` — Prompts the browser to download the linked resource rather than navigating
to it. The optional value is used as the suggested file name.
Only effective when href is set.
- **href**: `string | undefined` — The URL the button points to. When set, the component renders as an
<a> element instead of a <button>, enabling navigation on click.
Use together with target, download, and rel for full anchor semantics.
A disabled link renders a disabled <button> with the link role, because an
anchor has no disabled state.
- **rel**: `string | undefined` — The relationship between the current document and the linked URL.
Accepts a space-separated list of link types (e.g. 'noopener noreferrer').
Only effective when href is set. When target="_blank" is used,
setting rel="noopener noreferrer" is strongly recommended for security.
- **target**: `"_blank" | "_parent" | "_self" | "_top" | undefined` — Where to open the linked document. Only effective when href is set.
- '_self' – current browsing context (default browser behavior).
- '_blank' – new tab or window.
- '_parent' – parent browsing context; falls back to _self if none.
- '_top' – top-level browsing context; falls back to _self if none.
- **type**: `"reset" | "submit" | "button"` — The type of the button, which determines its behavior and semantics.
- 'button' – no default action; useful for custom JavaScript handlers.
- 'submit' – submits the associated form when clicked.
- 'reset' – resets the associated form fields to their initial values.

Ignored when the button is rendered as a link (i.e. href is set).
- **variant**: `ButtonVariant` — The variant of the button which determines its visual appearance.
- contained – filled background; highest visual emphasis (default).
- outlined – transparent background with a visible border.
- flat – no background or border; lowest visual emphasis.
- fab – floating action button shape; typically used for primary actions.
- **form**: `any` — The `<form>` element the button is associated with.
Resolved through the standard form-association mechanism - either the
closest ancestor `<form>` or the form referenced by the button's `form`
attribute. Returns `null` when no form is associated.
Relevant only when `type` is `'submit'` or `'reset'`.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the button.
- **click**(): void — Simulates a mouse click on the button, triggering its click handler and any associated form action.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the button.

### [IgrButtonGroup](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrButtonGroup)
Groups a series of toggle buttons together, exposing features such as layout and selection.

- **alignment**: `ContentOrientation` — The orientation of the buttons in the group.
- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether all buttons in the group are disabled.
- **selectedItems**: `string[]` — The values of the selected buttons. A button without a value is not in
the list.

When set, selects the buttons with these values. A single selection mode
selects only the first matching button.
- **selection**: `ButtonGroupSelection` — The selection mode of the group. A change of the mode clears the selection.

### [IgrCalendar](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCalendar)
A calendar that lets the user select a single date, multiple dates or a date range.

- **activeDate**: `Date` — The date that the calendar shows and highlights. It changes when the user navigates.
Without it, the calendar starts at its value, or at the current date when there is no value.
- **activeView**: `CalendarActiveView` — The active view of the calendar: days, months or years.
- **disabledDates**: `DateRangeDescriptor[] | undefined` — The date ranges that the user cannot select.
- **formatOptions**: `Pick<DateTimeFormatOptions, "month" | "weekday">` — The options used to format the months and the weekdays in the calendar views.
- **headerOrientation**: `CalendarHeaderOrientation` — The orientation of the calendar header.
- **hideHeader**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar hides its header.
In multiple selection mode, the header is always hidden.
- **hideOutsideDays**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar hides the dates that do not belong to the current month.
- **locale**: `string`
- **orientation**: `ContentOrientation` — The orientation of the calendar months when more than one month
is being shown.
- **resourceStrings**: `TGet`
- **selection**: `CalendarSelection` — The selection mode of the calendar: single, multiple or range.
A change after the first render clears the value and the values.
- **showWeekNumbers**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar shows the week numbers.
- **specialDates**: `DateRangeDescriptor[] | undefined` — The date ranges that the calendar marks as special.
- **value**: `Date | null` — The value of the calendar in `single` selection mode.
- **values**: `Date[]` — The values of the calendar in `multiple` and `range` selection modes.
- **visibleMonths**: `number` — The number of months displayed in the days view.
- **weekStart**: `WeekDays` — The first day of the week.

### [IgrCard](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCard)
A container component that wraps different elements related to a single subject.
The card component provides a flexible container for organizing content such as headers,
media, text content, and actions.

- **elevated**: `boolean` — Whether the card has an elevated appearance with a shadow.
When false, the card uses an outlined style with a border.

### [IgrCardActions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCardActions)
A container component for card action items such as buttons or icon buttons.
Actions can be positioned at the start, center, or end of the container.

- **orientation**: `ContentOrientation` — The orientation of the actions layout.

### [IgrCardContent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCardContent)
A container component for the card's main text content.
Use it in a card for the primary content.


### [IgrCardHeader](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCardHeader)
A container component for the card's header section.
Displays header content including an optional thumbnail, title, subtitle, and additional content.


### [IgrCardMedia](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCardMedia)
A container component for card media content such as images, GIFs, or videos.
Use it in a card for visual content.


### [IgrCarousel](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCarousel)
The carousel presents a set of slides by sequentially displaying a subset of one or more.

- **animationType**: `HorizontalTransitionAnimation` — The animation type.
- **disableLoop**: `boolean` — Whether the carousel stops at the first and the last slide instead of looping.
- **disablePauseOnInteraction**: `boolean` — Whether the carousel keeps playing when the user hovers over it or moves the
focus into it.
- **hideIndicators**: `boolean` — Whether the indicator controls (dots) are hidden.
- **hideNavigation**: `boolean` — Whether the navigation buttons are hidden.
- **indicatorsLabelFormat**: `string` — The format of the `aria-label` of the carousel indicators.
Each `{0}` changes to the number of the corresponding slide.
- **indicatorsOrientation**: `CarouselIndicatorsOrientation` — The position of the indicator controls (dots).
- **interval**: `number | undefined` — The duration in milliseconds between changing the active slide.
A positive value starts the automatic rotation.
- **locale**: `string`
- **maximumIndicatorsCount**: `number` — The maximum number of indicator controls (dots) that can be shown. With more slides,
a label shows instead of the dots.
- **resourceStrings**: `TGet`
- **slidesLabelFormat**: `string` — The format of the `aria-label` of the carousel slides, and of the label that
shows when the number of slides is greater than `maximumIndicatorsCount`.
Each `{0}` changes to the number of the slide, and each `{1}` to the total number of slides.
- **vertical**: `boolean` — Whether the carousel has vertical alignment.
- **current**: `any` — The index of the current active slide.
- **isPaused**: `any` — Whether the carousel is in paused state.
- **isPlaying**: `any` — Whether the carousel is in playing state.
- **slides**: `any` — The slides of the carousel.
- **total**: `any` — Total number of slides.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the carousel.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the carousel.
- **next**(): Promise<boolean> — Switches to the next slide, runs any animations, and returns whether the operation
was successful.
- **pause**(): void — Pauses the rotation of the carousel slides.
- **play**(): void — Resumes playing of the carousel slides.
- **prev**(): Promise<boolean> — Switches to the previous slide, runs any animations, and returns whether the operation
was successful.
- **select**(slide: IgcCarouselSlideComponent, animationDirection?: "next" | "prev"): Promise<boolean> — Switches to the passed-in slide, runs any animations, and returns whether the operation
was successful.
- **select**(index: number, animationDirection?: "next" | "prev"): Promise<boolean> — Switches to slide by index, runs any animations, and returns whether the operation
was successful.

### [IgrCarouselIndicator](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCarouselIndicator)
Used when a custom indicator needs to be passed to the carousel component.

- **active**: `boolean` — Whether the indicator is in its active state. The carousel sets this value.
- **index**: `number` — The zero-based position of the indicator in the set. The carousel sets this value.

### [IgrCarouselSlide](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCarouselSlide)
A single content container within a set of containers used in the context of a carousel.

- **active**: `boolean` — Whether the slide is the active slide of the carousel.
- **previous**: `boolean` — Whether the slide is the outgoing slide of a running transition.
The carousel sets this value.

### [IgrChat](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrChat)
A chat UI component for displaying messages, attachments, and input interaction.

- **draftMessage**: `IgcChatDraftMessage` — The chat message currently being composed but not yet sent.
Includes the draft text and any attachments.
- **locale**: `string`
- **messages**: `IgcChatMessage[]` — The list of chat messages currently displayed.
Use this property to set or update the message history.
- **options**: `IgcChatOptions | undefined` — The configuration object of the chat: behavior and appearance options,
suggestions and custom renderers.
- **resourceStrings**: `IgcChatResourceStrings & IChatResourceStrings` — The resource strings of the chat.
- **resourceStrings**: `TGet`
- **focusInput**(options?: FocusOptions): Promise<void> — Moves the focus to the text area of the chat input, after the first render
of a new chat. The promise resolves when the focus moves. A disconnected
chat does not wait. Does nothing when a custom input renderer replaces
the text area.
- **scrollToMessage**(messageId: string): void — Scrolls the view to a specific message by id.

### [IgrCheckbox](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCheckbox)
A check box allowing single values to be selected/deselected.

- **checked**: `boolean` — Whether the control is checked.
- **indeterminate**: `boolean` — Whether the checkbox is in the indeterminate state. A user click clears it.
- **labelPosition**: `ToggleLabelPosition` — The label position of the control.
- **value**: `string` — The value of the control, submitted when the control is checked.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the control.
- **click**(): void — Simulates a click on the control.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the control.

### [IgrChip](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrChip)
Chips help people enter information, make selections, filter content, or trigger actions.

- **disabled**: `boolean` — Whether the chip is disabled.
- **locale**: `string`
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the chip is outlined.
- **removable**: `boolean` — Whether the chip shows a remove control. A disabled chip hides it.
- **resourceStrings**: `TGet`
- **selectable**: `boolean` — Whether the chip can be selected.
- **selected**: `boolean` — Whether the chip is selected.
- **variant**: `StyleVariant | undefined` — The color variant of the chip.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the chip.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the chip.

### [IgrCircularGradient](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCircularGradient)
Defines a gradient stop for the fill of the circular progress.
Put it in the gradient slot of the circular progress. Each one becomes an SVG <stop> element.
The color, offset and opacity values go to the
stop-color, offset and stop-opacity of that element without validation.

- **color**: `string` — The color of the stop.
- **offset**: `string` — Where the stop sits along the gradient vector.
- **opacity**: `number` — The opacity of the stop.

### [IgrCircularProgress](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCircularProgress)
A circular progress indicator used to express unspecified wait time or display
the length of a process.

- **animationDuration**: `number` — The duration of the fill animation in milliseconds.
- **hideLabel**: `boolean` — Whether the default label is hidden.
- **indeterminate**: `boolean` — Whether the progress is indeterminate. An indeterminate progress has no
value and does not show the default label.
- **labelFormat**: `string` — Format string for the default label of the control.
Placeholders:
 {0} - current value of the control.
 {1} - max value of the control.
- **max**: `number` — The maximum value of the control.
- **value**: `number` — The value of the control.
- **variant**: `StyleVariant` — The variant of the control.

### [IgrColorPicker](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrColorPicker)
Color input component.

The user picks a color with the HSV saturation/value canvas, the hue slider
and the optional alpha slider. The user can also type a color string: hex,
rgb(a), hsl(a) or a named CSS color.

The component supports pre-defined swatches and the native EyeDropper API,
where the browser provides one. The anchor is a trigger button
(mode="default") or an editable text field (mode="input").

- **format**: `ColorFormat` — The color format of the string value.

A format change renders value in the new notation. The color does not
change, so the component emits no igcInput or igcChange.
- **hideFormats**: `boolean` — Whether the format select is hidden.
- **label**: `string | undefined` — The label of the component.

In mode="input" the component forwards the label to the anchor input.
In mode="default" it renders the label as a separate element.
- **locale**: `string`
- **mode**: `ColorPickerMode` — The mode of the color picker.

In "default" mode the anchor is a trigger button. In "input" mode the
anchor is an editable text field with a color swatch prefix. The prefix
also opens the picker.
- **open**: `boolean` — Whether the component is open.
- **resourceStrings**: `TGet`
- **scrollStrategy**: `PopoverScrollStrategy` — The behavior of the component when a parent container scrolls.

If the value is hide, the component hides while the anchor is fully out
of view. hide is the default value.

If the value is scroll, the component stays visible and anchored.

If the value is close, the component closes on each scroll.
- **showAlpha**: `boolean` — Whether to show the alpha slider and input.
- **swatches**: `string[]` — Pre-defined color strings. The component renders them as clickable
swatches below the picker controls. A click on a swatch sets its color as
the value.
- **value**: `string` — The value of the component as a CSS color string. Accepts hex, rgb(a),
hsl(a) and named colors.

An empty, whitespace-only or invalid string clears the value.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the color picker.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the color picker.
- **hide**(): Promise<boolean> — Closes the component. It does not emit events. The promise resolves to
false when the component is already closed, or when a later call
replaces this one.
- **show**(): Promise<boolean> — Opens the component. It does not emit events. The promise resolves to
false when the component is already open, or when a later call replaces
this one.
- **toggle**(): Promise<boolean> — Opens the component when it is closed, and closes it when it is open. It
does not emit events. The promise resolves to true when the state
changes.

### [IgrCombo](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrCombo)
The combo lets the user select one or more options from a list. Unlike the select, it shows the options in a
virtualized list, so the list can hold thousands of options.
The combo supports custom item templates, case-sensitive filtering, grouping and binding to complex data.

- **autofocus**: `boolean` — Whether the control takes the focus automatically.
- **autofocusList**: `boolean` — Whether the list of options, not the search input, takes the focus when
the list opens. It has no effect in single selection mode.
- **caseSensitiveIcon**: `boolean` — Whether the search input shows the icon that toggles case-sensitive
filtering. In remote filtering mode, read filteringOptions.caseSensitive
when you send the search to the server.
- **data**: `T[]` — The data source used to generate the list of options. A new data source
keeps the selection, also the selected items that it does not hold.
- **disableClear**: `boolean` — Whether the clear button is hidden.
- **disableFiltering**: `boolean` — Whether the filtering of the list of options is disabled. In multiple
selection mode, it also hides the search input.
- **displayKey**: `any | undefined` — The key in the data source used to display items in the list. Falls back
to `valueKey`.
- **filteringOptions**: `FilteringOptions<T>` — An object that configures the filtering of the combo.
- **groupHeaderTemplate**: `ComboGroupHeaderTemplate<T>` — The template used for the content of each combo group header.
- **groupKey**: `string | any | undefined` — The key in the data source used to group items in the list.
- **groupSelection**: `boolean` — Whether a group header is an option that selects the items of its group
that the list shows, or deselects them when all of them are selected.
Only in multiple selection mode with groupKey.
- **groupSorting**: `GroupingDirection` — The sort order of the groups, by their group value. With none, the
groups keep the order of the data source.
- **itemTemplate**: `ComboItemTemplate<T>` — The template used for the content of each combo item.
- **label**: `string | undefined` — The label of the control.
- **loading**: `boolean` — Whether the combo loads options. A spinner, which the loading slot can
replace, then takes the place of the toggle icon, and an empty list shows
a loading message instead of the empty message.
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the control has an outlined appearance.
- **placeholder**: `string | undefined` — The placeholder text of the control.
- **placeholderSearch**: `string` — The placeholder text of the search input.
- **selectionCommit**: `ComboSelectionCommit` — When the user's changes of the selection apply in multiple selection
mode. With confirm, they change a pending selection while the list is
open, and Enter or the Apply button applies it with one igcChange. Any
other close drops it. While it exists, the selection methods change it too.
- **showSelectAll**: `boolean` — Whether the list starts with an option that selects all the items that it
shows, or deselects them when all of them are selected. Only in multiple
selection mode.
- **singleSelect**: `boolean` — Whether only one item can be selected. In this mode, the main input
filters the list of options.
- **totalItemCount**: `number | undefined` — The number of all the items of a remote source, when the source knows it.
In remote filtering mode, the list shows a placeholder for each item that
data does not hold yet, so the scrollbar shows the full list.
- **value**: `ComboValue<T>[]` — The values of the selected items. With a `valueKey`, each value is that
field of an item. Without it, each value is the item itself.

The `value` attribute takes a JSON array. For a data source of objects,
set `valueKey` to select items through the attribute.
- **valueKey**: `any | undefined` — The key in the data source used when selecting items.
- **pendingValue**: `any` — The values of the pending selection in the confirm mode of
`selectionCommit`, which Enter, the Apply button or `commitSelection()`
applies. Without a pending selection, the same as `value`.
- **selection**: `any` — Returns the current selection as an array of objects as provided in the `data` source.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the component.
- **cancelSelection**(): void — Puts value back as the pending selection of the confirm mode. It does
not close the list.
- **commitSelection**(): void — Applies the pending selection of the confirm mode to value. It does not
emit igcChange or close the list.
- **deselect**(items?: Item<T> | Item<T>[]): void — Deselects options in the list by reference or by valueKey value. It
does not emit igcChange. Without an argument, it deselects all items.
- **deselectAllItems**(ignoreFilter?: boolean): void — Deselects all the items that the list shows. It does not emit igcChange.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the component.
- **select**(items?: Item<T> | Item<T>[]): void — Selects options in the list by reference or by valueKey value. It does
not emit igcChange. An object that data does not hold is selected as
it is. Without an argument, it selects all the items of data, or clears
the selection in single selection mode.
- **selectAllItems**(ignoreFilter?: boolean): void — Selects all the items that the list shows. It does not emit igcChange,
and does nothing in single selection mode.

### [IgrDatePicker](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrDatePicker)
A date field where the user types a date or selects one in a calendar.
The calendar opens in a dropdown or in a dialog.

- **activeDate**: `Date` — The date that the calendar shows and highlights.
Without it, the calendar starts at the value, or at the current date when there is no value.
- **disabledDates**: `DateRangeDescriptor[]` — The date ranges that the user cannot select in the calendar.
A value that includes one of these dates is invalid.
- **displayFormat**: `string` — The format of the value while the input does not have focus.
Without it, the input uses `inputFormat` when set, else the display format of the locale.
- **headerOrientation**: `CalendarHeaderOrientation` — The orientation of the calendar header. It applies only in dialog mode.
- **hideHeader**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar hides its header. In dropdown mode, the header is always hidden.
- **hideOutsideDays**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar hides the dates that do not belong to the current month.
- **inputFormat**: `string` — The date format of the input while the user edits the value.
Without it, the input uses the input format of the locale.
- **label**: `string` — The label of the picker.
- **locale**: `string`
- **max**: `Date | null` — The maximum value required for the picker to remain valid.
The calendar disables the dates after it.
- **min**: `Date | null` — The minimum value required for the picker to remain valid.
The calendar disables the dates before it.
- **mode**: `PickerMode` — Whether the calendar opens in a dropdown or in a modal dialog.
In dialog mode, the user cannot type in the input.
- **nonEditable**: `boolean` — Whether the user cannot type in the input. The user can still select a date in the calendar.
- **orientation**: `ContentOrientation` — The orientation of the multiple months displayed in the calendar's days view.
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the control has an outlined appearance.
- **placeholder**: `string` — The placeholder text of the control.
- **prompt**: `string` — The prompt symbol to use for unfilled parts of the mask.
- **readOnly**: `boolean` — Whether the control is read-only. The user cannot change the value or open the calendar.
- **resourceStrings**: `TGet`
- **showWeekNumbers**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar shows the week numbers.
- **specialDates**: `DateRangeDescriptor[]` — The date ranges that the calendar marks as special.
- **value**: `Date | null` — The value of the picker.

Only ever holds a committed value. While the user is typing in the input, the
intermediate state stays in the editor and is committed - together with an
`igcChange` event - when the edit is committed on blur. Use the `igcInput` event
to observe the value as it is being typed.
- **visibleMonths**: `number` — The number of months displayed in the calendar.
- **weekStart**: `WeekDays` — The first day of the week in the calendar.
- **selectionEnd**: `any` — The offset of the end of the text selection in the input, in UTF-16 code
units.
- **selectionStart**: `any` — The offset of the start of the text selection in the input, in UTF-16
code units. Equals `selectionEnd` when no text is selected.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the picker.
- **clear**(): void — Clears the value and the input text of the picker.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the picker.
- **select**(): void — Selects the text in the input of the component.
- **setRangeText**(replacement: string, start?: number, end?: number, mode?: RangeTextSelectMode): void — Replaces the text from start to end in the input and re-applies the
mask. Without start and end, replaces the selected text.
- **setSelectionRange**(start: number, end: number, direction?: SelectionRangeDirection): void — Sets the text selection range in the input of the component.
- **stepDown**(datePart?: DatePart, delta?: number): void — Decrements a date part by delta, or by 1. Without datePart, it changes the
part at the cursor or a default part.
- **stepUp**(datePart?: DatePart, delta?: number): void — Increments a date part by delta, or by 1. Without datePart, it changes the
part at the cursor or a default part.

### [IgrDateRangePicker](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrDateRangePicker)
A date range field where the user types a start and an end date or selects a range in a calendar.
The calendar opens in a dropdown or in a dialog.

- **activeDate**: `Date` — The date that the calendar shows and highlights.
Without it, the calendar starts at the value, or at the current date when there is no value.
- **customRanges**: `CustomDateRange[]` — The custom date ranges that the picker shows as chips. A click on a chip selects its range.
- **disabledDates**: `DateRangeDescriptor[]` — The date ranges that the user cannot select in the calendar.
A value that includes one of these dates is invalid.
- **displayFormat**: `string` — The format of the value while the input does not have focus.
Without it, the input uses `inputFormat` when set, else the display format of the locale.
- **headerOrientation**: `CalendarHeaderOrientation` — The orientation of the calendar header. It applies only in dialog mode.
- **hideHeader**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar hides its header. In dropdown mode, the header is always hidden.
- **hideOutsideDays**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar hides the dates that do not belong to the current month.
- **inputFormat**: `string` — The date format of the input while the user edits the value.
Without it, the input uses the input format of the locale.
- **label**: `string` — The label of the picker.
- **labelEnd**: `string` — The label of the end input.
- **labelStart**: `string` — The label of the start input.
- **locale**: `string`
- **max**: `Date | null` — The maximum value required for the picker to remain valid.
The calendar disables the dates after it.
- **min**: `Date | null` — The minimum value required for the picker to remain valid.
The calendar disables the dates before it.
- **mode**: `PickerMode` — Whether the calendar opens in a dropdown or in a modal dialog.
In dialog mode, the user cannot type in the input.
- **nonEditable**: `boolean` — Whether the user cannot type in the input. The user can still select a date in the calendar.
- **orientation**: `ContentOrientation` — The orientation of the multiple months displayed in the calendar's days view.
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the control has an outlined appearance.
- **placeholder**: `string` — The placeholder text of the control (single input).
- **placeholderEnd**: `string` — The placeholder text of the end input.
- **placeholderStart**: `string` — The placeholder text of the start input.
- **prompt**: `string` — The prompt symbol to use for unfilled parts of the mask.
- **readOnly**: `boolean` — Whether the control is read-only. The user cannot change the value or open the calendar.
- **resourceStrings**: `TGet`
- **showWeekNumbers**: `boolean` — Whether the calendar shows the week numbers.
- **specialDates**: `DateRangeDescriptor[]` — The date ranges that the calendar marks as special.
- **usePredefinedRanges**: `boolean` — Whether the picker shows chips with predefined ranges.
- **useTwoInputs**: `boolean` — Whether the picker shows the start and the end date in two separate inputs.
- **value**: `DateRangeValue | null` — The value of the picker: a range with a `start` and an `end` date.
- **visibleMonths**: `number` — The number of months displayed in the calendar: 1 or 2.
- **visibleMonths**: `number` — The number of months displayed in the calendar.
- **weekStart**: `WeekDays` — The first day of the week in the calendar.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the picker.
- **clear**(): void — Clears the value and the input text of the picker.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the picker.
- **select**(value: DateRangeValue | null): void — Sets the value of the picker to value. It does not emit events.

### [IgrDateTimeInput](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrDateTimeInput)
An input field to enter and edit a date and time value, with configurable input and display formats.

- **displayFormat**: `string` — The format of the value while the input does not have focus.
Without it, the input uses `inputFormat` when set, else the display format of the locale.
- **inputFormat**: `string` — The date format of the input while the user edits the value.
Without it, the input uses the input format of the locale.
- **label**: `string` — The label for the control.
- **locale**: `string` — The locale used to format the display value. Without it, the input takes
its own `lang`, else the locale of the nearest ancestor that has a
`locale` (a component) or a `lang`, and then the global locale.
- **max**: `Date | null` — The maximum value required for the input to remain valid.
- **min**: `Date | null` — The minimum value required for the input to remain valid.
- **outlined**: `boolean` — Whether the control has an outlined appearance.
- **placeholder**: `string` — The placeholder text of the control.
- **spinDelta**: `DatePartDeltas | undefined` — The amount by which a step action increments or decrements each date part.
All values default to 1.
- **spinLoop**: `boolean` — Whether a spun date part wraps around at its limits.
When false, the part stops at its minimum or maximum.
- **value**: `Date | null` — The value of the input.

Only ever holds a committed value. While the user is typing, the intermediate
state lives in the masked text and is committed - together with an `igcChange`
event - when the edit is committed on blur. Use the `igcInput` event to observe
the value as it is being typed.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the control.
- **clear**(): void — Clears the value and the text of the input.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the control.
- **hasDateParts**(): boolean — Returns whether the input format has a date part: day, month or year.
- **hasTimeParts**(): boolean — Returns whether the input format has a time part: hours, minutes or seconds.
- **select**(): void — Selects all the text inside the input.
- **setRangeText**(replacement: string, start?: number, end?: number, selectMode?: RangeTextSelectMode): void — Replaces the text from start to end in the input and re-applies the mask.
Without start and end, replaces the selected text. The value updates at once.
- **stepDown**(datePart?: DatePart, delta?: number): void — Decrements a date or time part by delta, or by its spinDelta value.
Without datePart, it changes the part at the cursor or a default part.
The value updates at once.
- **stepDown**(datePart?: P, delta?: number): void — Decrements a date or time part by delta, or by its spinDelta value.
Without datePart, it changes the part at the cursor or a default part.
The value updates at once.
- **stepUp**(datePart?: DatePart, delta?: number): void — Increments a date or time part by delta, or by its spinDelta value.
Without datePart, it changes the part at the cursor or a default part.
The value updates at once.
- **stepUp**(datePart?: P, delta?: number): void — Increments a date or time part by delta, or by its spinDelta value.
Without datePart, it changes the part at the cursor or a default part.
The value updates at once.

### [IgrDialog](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrDialog)
A modal dialog component built on the native <dialog> element.

The dialog traps focus while open and blocks interaction with the rest
of the page (modal semantics). It supports animated open/close
transitions, a backdrop overlay, and multiple content areas
through named slots.

The component supports the
[Invoker Commands API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Invoker_Commands_API).
A button with command="--show", "--hide" or "--toggle" and a commandfor
that points to this element calls the matching method.

- **closeOnOutsideClick**: `boolean` — Whether a click on the backdrop, outside the dialog surface, closes the
dialog. The close emits the close events.

Has no effect when the dialog is not yet open.
- **hideDefaultAction**: `boolean` — Whether the default action button in the footer is hidden.

Has no effect when content is projected into the footer slot, because
the slot content replaces the default button.
- **keepOpenOnEscape**: `boolean` — Whether the dialog stays open when the user presses the Escape key.

Use it when the dialog guards unsaved work and needs an explicit user
action to close.
- **locale**: `string`
- **open**: `boolean` — Whether the dialog is open.

Setting it skips the animation and the close events. Use the show(),
hide() and toggle() methods for an animated transition.
- **resourceStrings**: `TGet`
- **returnValue**: `string | undefined` — The return value of the dialog.

Automatically set to the value of the submitter element when a
<form method="dialog"> inside the dialog is submitted. Can also
be set programmatically before calling hide().
- **title**: `string` — The title displayed in the dialog header.

Overridden by any content projected into the title slot.
- **connectedCallback**(): void — Invoked when the component is added to the document's DOM.

In connectedCallback() you should setup tasks that should only occur when
the element is connected to the document. The most common of these is
adding event listeners to nodes external to the element, like a keydown
event handler added to the window.

connectedCallback() {
  super.connectedCallback();
  addEventListener('keydown', this._handleKeydown);
}


Typically, anything done in connectedCallback() should be undone when the
element is disconnected, in disconnectedCallback().
- **hide**(): Promise<boolean> — Closes the dialog with an animated fade-out transition.

Returns true when the dialog was successfully closed, or false if it
was already closed or closing, the transition was superseded by a newer
one, or open was set to false and then to true during it.
- **show**(): Promise<boolean> — Opens the dialog with an animated fade-in transition.

Returns true when the dialog was successfully opened, or false if it
was already open or opening, the transition was superseded by a newer one,
or open was set to false during it.
- **toggle**(): Promise<boolean> — Toggles the dialog open or closed depending on its current state.

Equivalent to calling show() when closed and hide() when open.
Returns true when the transition completed successfully, with the same
false cases as these methods.

### [IgrDivider](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrDivider)
Shows a horizontal or vertical rule as a break between content on a page.

- **middle**: `boolean` — Whether the --inset value shrinks the line from both sides, not only from the start.
- **type**: `DividerType` — The style of the divider line: solid or dashed.
- **vertical**: `boolean` — Whether to render a vertical divider line.

### [IgrDropdown](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrDropdown)
Shows a list of items in a popup next to a target element. The user
selects one item from the list.

- **distance**: `number` — The distance from the target element.
- **flip**: `boolean` — Whether the dropdown flips to the opposite side of the target when it does not fit in the visible area.
It flips back when its preferred side has enough space again.
- **keepOpenOnOutsideClick**: `boolean` — Whether the component stays open when the user clicks outside of it.
- **keepOpenOnSelect**: `boolean` — Whether the component stays open after the user selects an item.
- **open**: `boolean` — Whether the component is open.
- **placement**: `PopoverPlacement` — The preferred placement of the component around the target element.
- **sameWidth**: `boolean` — Whether the dropdown has the same width as the target.
- **scrollStrategy**: `PopoverScrollStrategy` — The behavior of the component when a parent container scrolls.

If the value is hide, the component hides while the anchor is fully out
of view. hide is the default value.

If the value is scroll, the component stays visible and anchored.

If the value is close, the component closes on each scroll.
- **groups**: `any` — Returns the group items of the dropdown.
- **items**: `any` — Returns the items of the dropdown.
- **selectedItem**: `any` — Returns the selected item from the dropdown or null.
- **clearSelection**(): void — Clears the current selection of the dropdown.
- **hide**(): Promise<boolean> — Closes the component. It does not emit events. The promise resolves to
false when the component is already closed, or when a later call
replaces this one.
- **navigateTo**(value: string): IgcDropdownItemComponent | null — Navigates to the item with the specified value. If it exists, returns the found item, otherwise - null.
- **navigateTo**(index: number): IgcDropdownItemComponent | null — Navigates to the item at the specified index. If it exists, returns the found item, otherwise - null.
- **select**(value: string): IgcDropdownItemComponent | null — Selects the item with the specified value. If it exists, returns the found item, otherwise - null.
- **select**(index: number): IgcDropdownItemComponent | null — Selects the item at the specified index. If it exists, returns the found item, otherwise - null.
- **show**(target?: string | HTMLElement): Promise<boolean> — Opens the dropdown. It does not emit events. The optional target is the
anchor element, or its ID. The promise resolves to false when the
dropdown is already open or has no anchor, or when a later call replaces
this one.
- **show**(): Promise<boolean> — Opens the component. It does not emit events. The promise resolves to
false when the component is already open, or when a later call replaces
this one.
- **toggle**(target?: string | HTMLElement): Promise<boolean> — Opens the dropdown when it is closed, and closes it when it is open. It
does not emit events. The optional target is the anchor element for
the open, or its ID. The promise resolves to true when the state
changes.
- **toggle**(): Promise<boolean> — Opens the component when it is closed, and closes it when it is open. It
does not emit events. The promise resolves to true when the state
changes.

### [IgrDropdownGroup](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrDropdownGroup)

### [IgrExpansionPanel](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrExpansionPanel)

- **hide**(): Promise<boolean> — Hides the panel content.
- **show**(): Promise<boolean> — Shows the panel content.

### [IgrFileInput](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrFileInput)
A form control that lets the user select one or more files, or a folder.

- **accept**: `string` — The file types the control accepts, as a comma-separated list.
- **autofocus**: `boolean` — Whether the control receives focus automatically.
- **directory**: `boolean` — Whether the user selects a folder instead of files. The selection then holds
every file in the folder and its subfolders, and the webkitRelativePath of

- **label**: `string` — The label for the control.

- **multiple**: `boolean` — Whether the control allows the user to select more than one file.

- **placeholder**: `string` — The placeholder text of the control.

- **value**: `string` — The value of the control: the name of the first selected file, as the native file input gives it.
As for the native file input, only an empty string can be set. It clears the selection.
- **files**: `any` — The list of selected files.
- **blur**(): void — Removes focus from the control.
- **focus**(options?: FocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the control.
- **select**(): void — Selects all the text inside the input.

### [IgrGridLite](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrGridLite)
IgcGridLite is a web component for displaying data in a tabular format quick and easy.

Out of the box it provides row virtualization, sort and filter operations (client and server side),
the ability to template cells and headers and column hiding.

- **adoptRootStyles**: `boolean`
- **autoGenerate**: `boolean` — Whether the grid will try to "resolve" its column configuration based on the passed
data source.
- **columns**: `ColumnConfiguration<T>[]` — Sets the column configuration for the grid.
- **data**: `T[]` — The data source for the grid.
- **dataPipelineConfiguration**: `DataPipelineConfiguration<T>` — Configuration object which controls remote data operations for the grid.
- **filterExpressions**: `FilterExpression<T>[]` — Set the filter state for the grid.
- **sortingExpressions**: `SortingExpression<T>[]` — Set the sort state for the grid.
- **sortingOptions**: `GridLiteSortingOptions` — Sort configuration property for the grid.
- **dataView**: `any` — Returns the state of the data source after sort/filter operations
have been applied.
- **rows**: `any` — Returns the collection of rendered row elements in the grid.
- **totalItems**: `any` — The total number of items in the dataView collection.
- **clearFilter**(key?: Keys<T>): void — Resets the current filter state of the control.
- **clearSort**(key?: Keys<T>): void — Resets the current sort state of the control.
- **filter**(config: FilterExpression<T> | FilterExpression<T>[]): void — Performs a filter operation in the grid based on the passed expression(s).
- **getColumn**(id: number | Keys<T>): ColumnConfiguration<T> | undefined — Returns a ColumnConfiguration for a given column.
- **navigateTo**(row: number, options?: NavigateToOptions<T>): Promise<void> — Navigates to a position in the grid based on provided row index and column field.
- **navigateTo**(row: number, column?: Keys<T>, activate?: boolean): Promise<void> — **Deprecated:** Use navigateTo(row, options) instead. Navigates to a position in the grid based on provided row index and column field.
- **sort**(expressions: SortingExpression<T> | SortingExpression<T>[]): void — Performs a sort operation in the grid based on the passed expression(s).

### [IgrGridLiteColumn](https://www.infragistics.com/api/react/igniteui-react/19.11/classes/IgrGridLiteColumn)
